description: This file defines the CallsViewList class, which extends ViewList, and contains logic for processing the list view of calls in the SuiteCRM application. It manages search form processing, display column setup, and rendering of the list view, including handling search filters and saved searches.

classes.name: CallsViewList
classes.description: A view class for listing calls, extending the generic ViewList class, with specific processing for call list views including search handling and display setup.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Handles the processing of the list view for calls, including search processing, setting up display columns, and rendering the list view based on request parameters and user interactions.
